style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original premium dark fantasy ARPG inventory equipment icon. Detailed hand-painted digital illustration, tactile medieval materials, fine craftsmanship, restrained weathering, convincing volume, warm upper-left light and subtle edge highlights. Three-quarter view, centered isolated object occupying 76 to 82 percent of a square canvas, ALL edges completely visible with generous clear margins. Genuine transparent background with clean alpha edges. No floor, no shadows outside the object, no white haze, no glow cloud, no colored fringe. No humans, body, face, mannequin, hands wearing the equipment, scenery, letters, text, border, watermark or additional equipment. Keep silhouettes clear and readable at 48 pixels. Subject:
